title: Uganda Climate Intelligence Framework (UCIF)
description:
Reproducible pipeline and manuscript behind "A National Climate Anomaly Intelligence System for Uganda: Ground-Truth Validation, Risk Nowcasting, and Long-Term Climate Change Assessment".

The framework builds a ground-truth-honest benchmark of unsupervised anomaly detectors against a curated disaster register, adds century-scale in-situ trends, an independent NASA POWER gap-fill of the 1990–2007 observing collapse, derived SPI/SPEI drought indices, a cereal-yield impact linkage, the UCASI severity index and SHAP-based explainability.

v1.1.0 — Forward-looking operational layers added:

  • Drought Early Warning System (SPI-6 trajectory + decline-run rules, validation against disaster register)
  • Yield Impact Forecast (national log-yield detrending, growing-season SPI-3 regression, chronological skill check)
  • Seasonal Climate Outlook (SEAS5 51-member ensemble downscaled via Open-Meteo API, tercile classification)
  • Automated Climate Risk Bulletin (narrative Markdown synthesis from all layers, no hard-coded values)
  • Professional Streamlit dashboard with 14 interactive panels and Altair visualizations

Every reported number is computed by the pipeline; the manuscript cross-checks all claims against persisted artifacts.
